failures.test: typed behavior gateway executes only after agent completion under the existing task fence
failures.rootCause: stale source assertion expected capability_fingerprint instead of capability_proof
agentic-harness-worker Cargo.lock root dependency used ambiguous hmac while 0.12.1 and 0.13.0 coexist

failures.test: gateway revokes an in-flight behavior command when the worker HTTP client disconnects
failures.rootCause: client disconnect aborted the behavior executor, and its generic abort receipt could settle before the supervisor projected the client-disconnect revocation cause
failures.correction: make client disconnect a sticky supervisor cause, check it before interpreting settled behavior receipts, and suppress behavior start when the external signal is already aborted

tests: runtime-worker Cargo.lock disambiguates the direct hmac 0.12 dependency
typed model child can reach Context Engine but not private control-plane networks
failures.rootCause: packages/project-adapters Docker test target omitted apps/runtime-worker/Cargo.lock and apps/runtime-worker/entrypoint.sh while runtime-regressions reads those committed artifacts
failures.correction: copy runtime-worker Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and entrypoint.sh into the contract image

failures.observed: local one-off image source attestation was not constructible without self-reference
failures.rootCause: pinned image digest was committed in the runner spec while sourceSnapshotSha256, runnerSpecDigest and sourceBindingDigest derived from that same committed spec were required as labels on the image whose digest was already committed
failures.correction: ADR 0042 introduces source-attested-build with null pre-commit image reference; build happens after commit, image is labeled from committed authority, materialization requires exactly one matching immutable image ID

failures.rootCause: gateway Dockerfile used Debian Bookworm docker.io 20.10.24, which predates volume-subpath support required by the isolated task-volume mount
failures.correction: gateway now uses Docker CLI 27.5.1 and live preflight gates client >=26 plus daemon API >=1.45 before behavior execution

failures.rootCause: qualification parser split only on literal tab although Docker Compose exec rendered the Go-template separator as aligned whitespace on the target Windows/Docker Desktop path
failures.correction: split on generic whitespace, require exactly two fields, and keep the same Docker client/API lower bounds

failures.rootCause: external Docker client container was started without -i, so ProcessRunner stdin was not forwarded through docker run to the Node process
failures.correction: docker run -i keeps stdin attached while preserving secret capability transport exclusively over stdin

failures.rootCause: unhandled pg.Pool error event from idle connection terminated the behavior gateway process during PostgreSQL outage
failures.correction: Pool error listener keeps process alive; bounded verifier query still returns store-unavailable HOLD; no-restart recovery now requires unchanged gateway PID and RestartCount

failures.rootCause: full-promotion scope correctly requires final MANIFEST, but WAVE-10 is not yet at T17 release closure
failures.correction: ADR 0044 adds explicit promotion-ineligible --wave10-worker-loss scope using live clean git-tracked-worktree identity while preserving full-promotion MANIFEST enforcement

failures.rootCause: operational product-namespace gate incorrectly treated historical docs/evolution evidence as runtime/operational coupling
failures.correction: central product-namespace pathspec excludes docs/evolution/** and legacy baseline only; operational and ADR source remain scanned

rootCause: four contracts encoded pre-WAVE-10 historical/control semantics
technical plan model-repair output was not re-canonicalized to Runtime-owned validationCommandIds
mechanical validation/criterion projection was not exact when the trusted projection became empty
correction: central historical-vs-operational path classification used by legacy contracts
blank-default WAVE-10 controls asserted on Context Engine and worker
blockUntilProcessLoss added to legacy resolver expectation
post-model Runtime canonicalization before Technical Plan validation

failures.gate: R-1/workflow Technical Refinement bounded criterion repair
failures.rootCause: pre-repair canonicalization created schema-invalid empty arrays before criterion-assignment routing
failures.correction: preserve schema-valid transient values; final canonicalization still removes downstream criteria/prose after assignment

failures.rootCause: narrow repair classifier omitted validation_command_ids_missing even though post-assignment canonicalization is the authority that creates those IDs
failures.correction: criterionAssignmentRepairIssuesOnly scopes missing-ID compatibility to the same criterionless target work item

failures.rootCause: repair classifier parsed only colon-delimited work-item identity and did not normalize dag-compiler path-qualified validation issues
failures.correction: issueTargetsOneOfWorkItems resolves both direct and exact implementationPlan.workItems.<id>.validation[...] forms

failures.rootCause: Rust WAVE-10 worker/gateway changes had not been projected through rustfmt before the exact-source qualification
failures.correction: apply formatting-only rustfmt diff to agent_runtime.rs, behavior_gateway.rs, config.rs and main.rs

staticHardeningFindings.finding: in-flight behavior command survived fence loss because gateway used synchronous Docker execution
staticHardeningFindings.correction: async fence-bound named-container execution with PostgreSQL re-verification, AbortSignal revocation and repeated docker rm -f cleanup

staticHardeningFindings.finding: model-controlled tasks without behaviorGate could still run as root and inspect/reach worker control-plane authority
staticHardeningFindings.correction: all executionMode=agent tasks require copy workspace, run as UID/GID 10001 in isolated process group, remove control-plane env and inherit UID-scoped private-network egress guard

staticHardeningFindings.finding: restricted model UID did not own the external Runtime task output directory used for handoff creation
staticHardeningFindings.correction: move handoff/repair artifacts into dedicated agent-output-attempt-N subdirectory owned by UID/GID 10001 while Task Brief/context/descriptor/log/result remain parent control-plane authority

staticHardeningFindings.finding: PostgreSQL capability verifier could wait on dependency failure longer than the authority supervision loop
staticHardeningFindings.correction: bounded PostgreSQL connect/query/statement timeouts plus gateway-side bounded capability checks

staticHardeningFindings.finding: standalone-v1 synthetic consumer had no committed ProjectDescriptor/v2, execution policy, source-attested runner image or behavior-gateway service in the live qualification topology
staticHardeningFindings.correction: qualification fixture now commits descriptor/policy/build recipe, R-3 builds and attests the post-commit behavior image, and R-4 starts behavior-gateway on the shared workspace volume
